collection.heading: Information we collect
collection.body: OpenRed collects information that you provide to us directly when you register on our platform, including your name, email address, and radiation measurement data.

usage.heading: Use of information
usage.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Respond to your comments and questions
Display measurement data in aggregated form

sharing.heading: Sharing information
sharing.body: Environmental measurement data may be shared publicly and anonymously for scientific research and public awareness purposes. We do not share personally identifiable information with third parties without your explicit consent.

security.heading: Data security
security.body: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at frasanz@ibercivis.es

cookies.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve the user experience, keep sessions active, and analyze the use of our platform.

googleAuth.heading: Google authentication
googleAuth.body: When you use Google authentication, we receive basic profile information (name and email address) according to the permissions you grant. We do not have access to your Google password.

accountDeletion.heading: Account and data deletion
accountDeletion.intro: As a user of OpenRed (developed by Fundación Ibercivis), you may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time. To do so, follow these steps:
steps: Send an email to frasanz@ibercivis.es from the email address registered with OpenRed.
Use the subject line: "Account deletion request".
Include in the message body your username or the email address you registered with.
You will receive a confirmation within 72 hours, and your account will be deleted within a maximum of 30 calendar days from confirmation.
accountDeletion.deletedIntro: Once the request is processed, the following personal data will be permanently deleted:
deletedItems: First name, last name, and email address.
Password and authentication credentials (including any linked Google account).
Identifiers and tokens associated with your devices.
accountDeletion.retainedIntro: For scientific, legal, and security reasons, the following data will be retained after account deletion:
retainedItems: Environmental measurements (gamma radiation and light pollution) in anonymized and aggregated form, with no link to the user, for scientific research and public dissemination. Retained indefinitely.
Access records and security logs required to detect fraud and abuse. Retained for a maximum of 12 months.
Minimum information required to comply with applicable legal, tax, or accounting obligations, for the period required by law (up to 6 years for accounting obligations in Spain).

dataDeletion.heading: Partial data deletion without deleting your account
dataDeletion.intro: OpenRed (developed by Fundación Ibercivis) also allows you to request deletion of part of your data without closing your account. To do so, follow these steps:
steps: Send an email to frasanz@ibercivis.es from the email address registered with OpenRed.
Use the subject line: "Partial data deletion request".
Specify in the message body which data you wish to delete (for example: measurements from a specific date range, measurements from a particular device, location data, etc.).
You will receive a confirmation within 72 hours, and the requested data will be deleted within a maximum of 30 calendar days from confirmation.
dataDeletion.deletableHeading: Data you may request to delete while keeping your account
deletableItems: Individual measurements (gamma radiation or light pollution) linked to your account or to a specific device.
Location data (GPS coordinates) associated with your measurements.
Device metadata (identifiers and tokens) that you no longer use.
Optional profile information you have provided (for example, display name or preferences).
dataDeletion.retainedIntro: Even if you request the deletion of part of your data, OpenRed will retain the following data to keep the service running and to comply with legal obligations:
retainedItems: Basic account data (email, credentials) while your account remains active.
Anonymized and aggregated versions of the deleted measurements, with no link to the user, for scientific research purposes. Retained indefinitely.
Access records and security logs. Retained for a maximum of 12 months.
Minimum information required by applicable legal, tax, or accounting obligations (up to 6 years in Spain).

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the new policy on this page.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using OpenRed, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you must not use this service.

description.heading: Description of the service
description.body: OpenRed is a citizen science platform for the measurement and visualization of environmental data, including gamma radiation and light pollution. The service allows users to record, visualize, and share environmental measurements.

registration.heading: Registration and user account
registration.intro: To use certain features of the service, you must create an account. You are responsible for:
items: All activities that occur under your account
Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: By using OpenRed, you agree to:
items: Not upload false or misleading data
Not attempt to access other users' accounts
Not use the service for illegal activities
Not interfere with the operation of the service

data.heading: Data and measurements
data.body: The measurement data you upload to OpenRed may be used in an aggregated and anonymous form for scientific research and public visualization. You retain the rights to your individual data, but you grant OpenRed a non-exclusive license to use it as described in our Privacy Policy.

scientificContent.heading: Scientific content
scientificContent.body: The information provided on OpenRed is for educational and informational purposes. It does not constitute professional advice. Environmental measurements must be interpreted by qualified professionals.

availability.heading: Service availability
availability.body: We strive to keep OpenRed available 24/7, but we do not guarantee that the service will be free of errors or interruptions. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the service at any time.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: OpenRed is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.

intellectualProperty.heading: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The content, features, and functionality of OpenRed are the property of Fundación Ibercivis and are protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

modifications.heading: Modifications to the terms
modifications.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes. Continued use of the service after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

termination.heading: Termination
termination.body: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately if you breach these Terms of Service. You may terminate your account at any time by contacting us.

governingLaw.heading: Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Spain. Any dispute shall be resolved in the courts of Zaragoza, Spain.
